name: Pint glass
note: Imperial pint; the standard glass for beer and beer cocktails like a Michelada.
iceDisplacementNote: Solid ice only. No measured figure exists for this shape; scaled from the highball and Collins on this site, both of which land near 57% of capacity displaced by cubed ice, about 95% of that figure for a single block and roughly a quarter more for crushed. Crushed is taken as 7% above cubed: loose crushed ice weighs about 593 to 640 kg per cubic metre against 917 for solid ice, roughly 65% solid, where loose cubes run about 61%.
